description: This file contains template functions for im2col and col2im operations used in convolution implementations within the ATen library, part of PyTorch's tensor computation backend.

methods.name: im2col
methods.description: Performs the im2col operation transforming image data into columnar format for convolution.

methods.name: col2im
methods.description: Performs the col2im operation reconstructing image data from columnar format.
